notes.title: 1.0 Update!
notes.notes:
The 1.0 update has arrived!!!
This marks the end of the early access of Void Survivors, thanks to everyone who has accompanied us during this wild ride! And what better way to mark this milestone than with a big content update!!

This update brings additions such as:

A new unlockable map: The void
A new unlockable game mode: No hit
2 new skill trees: Spike & Astral Bolt
4 new customizable sets
Difficulty modifiers balanced
Balance in bosses and waves difficulty

notes.title: 0.9.8 Update and 1.0 release week
notes.notes:
A new update has been uploaded to address some bugs and issues. This update also comes before 1.0 which will come next week!

This next is a list of the bugs fixed:

- A bug selecting a head/body/back parts with a mouse.
- A bug selecting a weapon with a mouse.
- A bug when a spike enemy dies too quickly.
- The diagonal movement has been adjusted.

notes.title: 0.9.5 Update!
notes.notes:
A new content update has come to Void Survivors!!! This update brings changes such as:

- New upgrades for all weapons types:
   Range: Now you can unlock the chance of shooting bouncing bullets.
   Melee: Now you can unlock a double sword trail and the chance of shooting 6 trails at once.
   Explosive: Now you can unlock throwing grenades to random positions.
   Laser: Now you can unlock the chance of shooting 4 rays at once.
   Throw: Now you can unlock a summon scythe that circles around you damaging enemies.
   Magic:  Now you can unlock magic missiles that fire circling around you.

- The SMG weapons have been nerfed a 5% to balance them with other weapons.

- All weapons costs have been reduced.

-  Now you can increase enemies' difficulty values up to 200%

- Now you can take screenshots from the game.

Thats all! The next update will be the biggest one yet, bringing all sorts of new content, and will also mark the end of the early access of the game. Stay tuned!

notes.title: 0.9 Update!
notes.notes:
A new content update has come to Void Survivors!!! This update brings changes such as:

- All elite enemies have active attacks now, they no longer only stalk you.

- Bosses attacks have been improved to increase their difficulty.

- To balance elites' and bosses' challenges the experience they give when defeated has been multiplied by 2.5.

- Spells, summons and mercenaries skill trees have been rebalanced to reduce their numbers and avoid the sense of meaningless skills, 17 upgrades have been removed.

- The camera has been improved to avoid lagging effects.

Thats all! The next update will focus on replacing some weapons upgrades to make them more diverse and fun, and adding the new map "The Void". Stay tuned!

notes.title: 0.8.5 Update
notes.notes:
A new content update has come to Void Survivors!!! This update brings changes such as:

- Adjustments to the camera to smooth movement and reduce the "lagging" camera error.

- A new rune focus on mercenaries builds.

- Improvements to the art of the levels.

- Fix the HP of the first elite enemy on the lab level.

notes.title: 0.8.4 Update
notes.notes:
A new content update has come to Void Survivors!!! This update brings changes such as:

- A new enemy has been added to the forest level "The bomber"

- A new enemy has been added to the lab level "Shotgun Experiment"

- Two new skill trees available from the start (Poison and a drone mercenary).

- 11 new cosmetics parts and achievements.

notes.title: 0.8.0 First content update!
notes.notes:
I'm proud to announce that the first content update has come to Void Survivors!!! This update brings numerous changes such as:

- The addition of an "Auto-Shoot" option before starting a run, to balance the auto-shoot players' scores with the manual-shooting ones I decided that manual-shooting players will have a 1.5 more score multiplier.

- There's a new score bonus for completing a run defeating death, this bonus is incremental depending the map you´re playing (1000 more score for the forest level, 2000 for the lab level, and 3000 for the temple level)

- A new enemy has been added to the forest level "Slime Jumper".

- A new enemy has been added to the lab level "Laser Experiment".

- A new enemy has been added to the temple level "Shaman Deep One".

notes.title: Day 2 Patch
notes.notes:
The update 0.7.7 is officially out! Includes a set of fixes for bugs reported by the community such as:

- An error that didn't allow unlocking some achievements.
- An error that didn't stop the screen-shake even when with the option selected.
- An error that crashes the game when choosing the freeze shop upgrade.
- An error that stopped the music after 5 minutes.
